def circular_shift(x, shift):
    s = str(x)
    sign = ''
    if s.startswith('-'):
        sign = '-'
        s = s[1:]
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        return sign
    shift %= n
    shifted = s[-shift:] + s[:-shift] if shift else s
    return sign + shifted
